newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle activity was "dead slow", with "absolutely nothing going on," a market source said.
This week's showlists were reportedly sold out, with top prices at $113.00 per cwt on a dressed basis. Top prices on a live basis were reported in western Nebraska at $70.00.

Feedlot cattle next week were seen priced at $115.00 on a dressed basis and $71.00 to $72.00, live, sources said. This week's sales were pegged at 80,500, well above the estimated showlist of 73,300. Next week's showlist was seen steady to smaller than this week's.
